items.title: Katie Britt's face as a Hawks/Hawkeyes perjury gotcha collapses
items.summary: At Jack Smith's Senate Judiciary hearing, Sen. Eric Schmitt called Smith a "dirtbag" and accused him of perjury, citing texts from Smith's staff that he said put Smith at a Warriors-Hawks game in Atlanta the day after Fani Willis disclosed her relationship with Nathan Wade. Smith said the only game he remembered was Iowa at Maryland, to watch Caitlin Clark, and Sen. Amy Klobuchar checked and confirmed it ("Could it then be that the University of Iowa is the Hawkeyes?"), and Sahil Kapur's clip of the full exchange got 32K likes. MS NOW's slow zoom on Sen. Katie Britt, sitting next to Schmitt with her mouth open, became the moment: she never explained the look, but people read it as secondhand embarrassment, @thepondering_'s clip got 40K likes, and the face spread as a reaction GIF far beyond politics, set to the Curb Your Enthusiasm theme and captioned for any "something just went very wrong" moment.

post.name: Sahil Kapur
post.text:
A phenomenal moment in the Senate.

Eric Schmitt, R-Mo., claims he has evidence Jack Smith went to a HAWKS game in Atlanta.

Smith denies it.

Schmitt declares he has busted Jack Smith for perjury.

Smith, vexed, says he went to HAWKEYES game in Maryland.
